# Doppel 1.1.9
- Harden deep-link routing and OAuth callback handling across managed instances, including stale shared-handler recovery. - Expand release QA with ASAR integrity and OAuth routing checks. - Improve update reconciliation and engine lifecycle handling for edge cases encountered during vendor app updates.

# Doppel 1.1.8
- Installing a ChatGPT update no longer stops when a profile is using the built-in browser. That profile runs through the untouched official app rather than through its own clone, and Doppel previously had no way to put such a window back, so it refused the whole update and asked you to quit the window yourself. It now closes that window along with everything else and reopens it on the same profile, with the same account data and the vendor's own updater still disabled. It still stops before touching anything when the official window belongs to a different profile, to a profile Doppel does not manage, or when more than one is open, and it names the window to quit. - When ChatGPT asks you to confirm quitting, Doppel now brings that dialog to the front and gives you two minutes to answer it. ChatGPT refuses the quit request instantly and only then puts its "Quit ChatGPT?" dialog on screen, often behind another window, so Doppel used to give up after forty seconds and tell you to dismiss a keychain prompt that was never there. If it does still give up, it now tells you to click Quit in ChatGPT's own dialog.

# Doppel 1.1.7
- Removing or rebuilding an instance now stops its background helpers too. ChatGPT's crash reporter and modifier monitor used to keep running after the app had gone, pointing at a bundle that no longer existed, and they built up quietly over time. Sparkle's own updater and the Computer Use helpers are deliberately left alone. - `remove --purge-data` now also moves the instance's cache to the Trash, alongside its profile and `CODEX_HOME`. That cache was never cleaned up before, so it accumulated for every instance ever removed. The stock ChatGPT app's own cache is protected the same way its profile already was.
